title: Titan At A Glance + Titan Week
summary: Easy Nav is now a persistent keeper mode, with a configurable Titan Pie and a dedicated This Week Command Centre.
details: Easy Nav reduces navigation density without removing intelligence, records, genetics, reminders or any underlying feature.
The Titan Pie gives you 4–6 configurable live shortcuts that can be reordered and changed to fit your routine.
Titan Week now has its own full page with current and historical weeks, configurable week starts, weekly metrics, per-Titan targets and direct actions.
The command centre uses recorded keeper data and evidence-bound intelligence, so it does not invent missing events or turn trends into diagnoses.

whereToFind.label: Open Titan Week
whereToFind.hint: Titan Pie → This Week, or open the dedicated Command Centre
